name: Skarner
notes: The fight opens with Impale (R): its 0.75s cast plays out, then its magic damage lands and applies a Quaking stack; while it casts and while its suppression would run (0.75s + 1.5s), Shattered Earth (Q) is treated as locked out, matching the wiki's note that Q and E are disabled during Impale's cast and disable phase while W stays usable.

Shattered Earth (Q) has a 0.35s cast time (the dossier's castTime): casting it takes effect immediately (arming 3 empowered attacks and resetting the attack timer) and then keeps Skarner busy for 0.35s before any other cast or attack, as with every cast that has a cast time. It is recast as soon as it is off cooldown, subject to that busy time and the Impale lockout above.

The 3rd landed empowered attack additionally deals 11% of the target's max health and is treated as the moment Q's cooldown starts counting down, since the wiki's 'restarts on each landed empowered attack' rule means the effective earliest recast is always base cooldown after the last (3rd) landing.

Upheaval (Q's early-end alternate cast) is never manually used: the 3 empowered attacks are always allowed to land naturally in this fight, which delivers the same total damage Upheaval would have front-loaded.
Ixtal's Impact (E) is never cast: see the 'unused' field for why it deals no damage against a stationary dummy, and it does not apply a Quaking stack by itself either.
Seismic Bastion (W) is cast on cooldown for its magic burst; its self-shield is ignored since it only matters for survival, not damage.

Threads of Vibration (P): every landed basic attack (including Shattered Earth's empowered ones) and every landed Impale hit apply a stack of Quaking (max 3, 4s refresh). Whenever a hit brings the target to (or keeps it at) 3 stacks, an 8-tick, 0.5s-interval damage-over-time totaling the listed percent of the target's max health (re)starts from that hit; the wiki does not fully spell out whether a reapplication while already at 3 stacks restarts the DoT, so this is the assumed reading.

Shattered Earth's empowered bonus damage and its final slam are dealt as on-hit/proc damage (the wiki explicitly calls them proc damage) and are treated as unable to critically strike, since no crit interaction is stated.

Only the 3rd (final) empowered hit of Shattered Earth is treated as triggering ability-cast-keyed item procs, matching the wiki's note that only that hit triggers Tear of the Goddess / Archangel's Staff.
Mana costs are not modeled: no cost bookkeeping is kept, since the engine does not track mana or its regen and nothing here would need it to stay within a 15s fight.

unused.E: Ixtal's Impact only deals damage when a target it has grabbed collides with terrain during the charge; the dummy fight is against one stationary, non-moving dummy with no terrain to drag it into, so the charge can never end with a wall-slam and the ability has no damage instance to deal. It also does not apply a Quaking stack on its own (only the wall-slam does, and that never happens), so casting it contributes nothing to the fight and is left out of the rotation.
